title: Which Needs for Premature New-born Babies' Parents Facing Environmental and Social Difficulties ?
brief_summary: This study aims to understand parents' needs regarding social difficulties faced in a child's preterm birth context.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Parents (father or mother ) of a premature new-born baby (\< 37 SA) hospitalised in Besancon University Hospital at birth.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Parents \< 18 years old
* Refusing to participate
study_population: Parents of a premature new-born baby (\< 37 SA)
